title: Peter Lacasse, a fine trumpeter
summary: Robinson praises Peter Lacasse, who had his own orchestra and played with the Tuxedo and other brass bands.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Did you ever think of the name of that trumpet player he forgot?

He was still alive but he was. Peter Lacasse. Oh, Peter Lacasse. He's a good type of player. Red was a tough man. Who was he playing with? Oh, he had his own orchestra. Then he used to play with the Tuxedo Band. Played with Exorcist, Street Band, all the bands. You know? Peter Lacasse is a good man. They had some wonderful trumpet players in the yard.
